identificationModule.briefTitle: Orelabrutinib Combined With Rituximab and Chemotherapy for Relapsed/Refractory B-Cell Lymphoma Patients With Central Nervous System Involvement
identificationModule.officialTitle: Orelabrutinib Combined With Rituximab and Chemotherapy for Relapsed/Refractory B-Cell Lymphoma Patients With Central Nervous System Involvement

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This single-center, open, single-arm study aim to evaluate the efficacy and tolerability of a therapy introducing orelabrutinib on the basis of rituximab and chemotherapy in treating patients with relapsed or refractory B-cell lymphoma invloving central nervous system.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: Participants will receive orelabrutinib in addition to second-line therapy consisting of rituximab and recommended chemotherapy according to histopathologic type. After treatment of 6 cycles with the new regimen, the patients achieving CR or PR would go on to receive autologous haematopoietic stem cell transplantation (auto-HSCT) with or without orelabrutinib maintenance of 2 years (if tolerable) or orelabrutinib maintenance alone if intolerant to auto-HSCT.

armGroups.label: OR-chemo
armGroups.description: Drug: Orelabrutinib, Rituximab and recommended chemotherapy according to histopathologic type

interventions.name: Orelabrutinib
interventions.description: 150 mg qd po, until disease progression, intolerance of drug toxicity or death, otherwise maintaining during 2 years of follow-up

interventions.name: Rituximab
interventions.description: 375 mg/m\^2 ivgtt, D0 of each 28-day cycle

interventions.name: Chemotherapy
interventions.description: Not specified, recommended regimen according to histopathologic type

primaryOutcomes.description: The ORR is defined as percentage of participants with overall response including complete response (CR) and partial response (PR), on the basis of investigator assessments, according to 2014 Lugano criteria.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: At the end-of-therapy response evaluation, 6 weeks after the end of Cycle 6, each cycle lasting 4 weeks

secondaryOutcomes.description: Progression-free survival was defined as the time from the date of first treatment until the date of the first documented day of disease progression or relapse, according to 2014 Lugano criteria, or death from any cause, whichever occurred first.

otherOutcomes.description: Overall survival is defined as the time from the date of first treatment to the date of death from any cause.
otherOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline up to data cut-off (up to approximately 2 years)

otherOutcomes.description: The CR rate is defined as the percentage of participants with CR, on the basis of investigator assessments, according to 2014 Lugano criteria.
otherOutcomes.timeFrame: At the end-of-therapy response evaluation, 6 weeks after the end of Cycle 6, each cycle lasting 4 weeks

otherOutcomes.description: Any harmful reaction that occurs during the treatment of a disease according to the normal usage and dosage of a drug, which is unrelated to the purpose of treatment.
otherOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline up to data cut-off (up to approximately 2 years)

locations.facility: Ruijin Hospital, Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine
